reviews.x: I have a grain INTOLERANCE and also get inflammation from a list of chemicals normally in mascara this is so gentle while making my eyes pop!! Thank you!! It’s been over a year since I’ve worn any!!

I love the way this mascara makes my eyes look! However, I only wear this one on my top lashes. It will smear and I choose to wear Honeybee garden's other mascara on my bottom lashes which doesn't add as much volume but doesn't smear and run. I will say it is a little hard to get off at the end of the day.

I am horrible at taking selfies to see the before & after but this mascara is wonderful!  I love that it gives a natural look but also lengthens lashes and adds volume without heavy clumping.  And it stays all day without smearing.  Big plus that it is all natural without lots of chemicals. I am super sensitive & this mascara has given me zero irritation.  I found my new go-to daily mascara!
Hard to find a good mascara Thats also good for you. Adds volume and washes off easily. Very impressed with this product.
The product does smudge so one has to be careful applying it. Also, it takes some effort to remove it. Hope your eyes don’t water. Lashes look good if done right. Just a bit tricky.

Goes on very messy and smears extremely easy. Have to do a whole eye clean up after applying. The application itself is difficult. The mascara clips and the brush does not separate the lashes well. The product makes the lashes darker, but does not define or lengthen. It is easy to come off because it smears easily. The only upside is it did not irritate my eyes.... but my lashes look cheap.

I love Honeybee Gardens Bellissama mascara! This mascara is great at making my short lashes appear longer. I don't really need to apply a second coat to get results. Some reviewers said they can't use it on their bottom lashes because it flakes or smears. I hesitated ordering it for this reason but find it works perfectly for my bottom lashes as well. Honestly, this is the best mascara I have used and for less money than a lot of other brands. If you weren't blessed with long lashes you may just

Wow! I really like this mascara. I have tried over the years, many, many brands of mascara from cheap ones to very expensive ones, along with a host of all natural and organic brands. This is by far my favorite. I will buy this one again, love it!  Edit I still love this mascara after nearly a year of using this brand. I did try a couple of other brands, but came right back to this one. Best natural mascara ever.

Mascara and lip liner are my favorite from this brand. Also I’ve given the bay rum aftershave as a gift and heard really good feedback. I started ordering directly from their site, which is free shipping over $35, but the best part of ordering direct- the cute little glass animal in every shipment. Obsessed with my tiny glass zoo. Need to order more frequently to get more animals!

Goes on thick enough to define, lengthen and volumize but not clump.  Does not smudge or flake off all day.  Allows my curled eyelashes to stay curled.  Easy to remove.  Non irritating.  I have tried many different natural mascaras and this is by FAR my favorite!  The wand is different than I'm used to but I ended up really liking it!

reviews.t: The search for a good clean mascara continues...
reviews.x: I really wanted to like this mascara, and it looks OK when first applied: it lengthens, the consistency is decent, and it didn't irritate my eyes... Unfortunately it was flaking all over my face after about an hour. Will end up tossing the rest.

reviews.t: If it works for you, it will be the best mascara ever. It didn’t work for me.
reviews.x: Unfortunately, this flaked off under my eyes and gave me a slight raccoon eye. I love the brush and this is definitely volumizing. The only mascara I’ve ever had not flake is HBG original mascara.
I really like this brand of skin care & makeup. I have sensitive skin & celiac disease so having safe & vegan products that work well & are available means a lot to me.
Looked like a raccoon at the end of the day. Not a fan.

reviews.t: A GOOD GLUTEN FREE MASCARA ALTERNATIVE
reviews.x: The company from which I usually buy my gluten free mascara has been out of it for the last number of months, and since it was time for a replacement, I decided to try this mascara after the reviews I read.  I do like it, and it also has an organic smell to it instead of the smell of most mascaras.  It's a much better price than I was paying from other companies in the past, so I will most definitely buy this mascara again.

reviews.t: Lots of volume, a little smudge
reviews.x: This definitely has a lot more volume than the original HBG formula.  Only down side is that it smudges a bit throughout the day and I have to occassionally check to make sure I don't have raccoon eye towards the end of the day.  It also takes slightly longer to dry so you have to be careful not to sneeze :).  I think the volume is worth it, it looks great.

I really love this mascara. I’ve tried all kinds but this is the best. Goes on smooth with no clumps. I use a very light application to start after using an eyelash curler. Then I let it dry and use an eyelash curler again just before I apply another coat. The results are perfect. And it stays curled for the day.

This is the best mascara ever!  It's light weight, doesn't smudge, is very soft, there is no funny smell or fumes, looks natural, and cleans off easily.  My lashes break with normal mascara, and this stuff is so soft and my lashes do not break anymore!  I love it and would highly recommend it to anyone.

I have such a hard time with mascaras irritating my eyes and this one seems to work pretty well for me. It does nearly always smudge when applied to my lower lashes (mine are pretty long) but it is pretty easily and quickly fixed.

reviews.t: Too much mascara on the wand
reviews.x: Mascara itself seems very creamy and rich. I think this could be a really good, if the opening of the container were smaller, so not so much mascara is collected on the wand. It is way too much. I’m ending up not using it.

Smudges! First day wearing it and by mid day this is what it looked like. I’m careful about the eye creams or gels I use during the day, using nothing oil based so my mascara doesn’t smudge. But this one did, terribly!

It’s pretty smudgy but manageable. The only reason I’m writing a review is because the wand broke after using it only about 15 times. I only wear makeup a few times a month and I’ve had this mascara about 6 months.
Makes my thin lashes look thicker. Can apply a little or build thick lashes. Only thing if u apply heavier it will flake a tiny bit.still a good buy! Doesn't  break the bank🙂

reviews.t: Great mascara for people with ingredient sensitivities
reviews.x: Wonderful cosmetic line for people with ingredient sensitivities. I use the mascara, eye shadow, and eyeliner pencil with no reaction to the ingredients.
The product was old. It had a really strong chemical smell and when I put it on it felt like fumes were getting in my eyes. It was unsafe to use.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the volume, length, and definition it gives their lashes.
Several reviewers say it smears, smudges, or flakes, sometimes causing raccoon eyes.
Reviewers with sensitivities praise it for being gentle, non-irritating, and free of harsh chemicals.
Some reviewers find it difficult to apply or remove.
A few reviewers say it washes off easily.
